meta.scope: FFN Presales Engine and other internal FFN product surfaces, built by Build Theory Enterprise

tokens.name: brand-050
tokens.usage: Faintest brand tint. Selected table rows, active nav item ground, brand callout blocks. Never carries text of its own; pair with ink.

tokens.name: brand-100
tokens.usage: Brand tint one step up. Badge grounds for informational stages, chart fills under a trend line, avatar grounds.

tokens.name: brand-200
tokens.usage: Decorative brand tint border. Outlines brand-050 and brand-100 blocks so they hold an edge in both themes; it never marks an interactive boundary.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The FFN blue as text and icon colour: links, active tab labels, selected icons. Reads on surface, surface-raised and surface-page in both themes (light 7.5:1, dark 7.2:1). The dark value is lightened because the exact brand hex only reaches 2.6:1 on a dark ground.

tokens.name: brand-solid
tokens.usage: Brand as a FILL: primary buttons, the filled pipeline track, selected toggle. Always pairs with on-brand. The exact brand hex #233ce6 is used in light; dark lifts it so the button edge still reads 3.3:1 against surface-page.

tokens.name: brand-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for brand-solid controls. on-brand keeps 9.4:1 in light and 5.2:1 in dark.

tokens.name: brand-solid-active
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for brand-solid controls. Darker in light, lighter in dark; on-brand keeps 4.8:1 in the dark theme, which is why it is not lifted further.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-solid and its hover and active fills. 7.5:1 in light, 5.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px from the control. 7.5:1 on light grounds, 7.2:1 on dark. Never a shadow, never dashed.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The application background behind all panels. ink and ink-muted read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default panel ground: cards, tables, the sidebar, form wells. ink 19:1 light and 16:1 dark; ink-muted 6.5:1 and 8.0:1.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Ground for anything floating above a panel: modals, dropdown menus, popovers, toasts. Carries shadow-lg.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed ground: table headers, code and payload blocks, the empty pipeline track, disabled inputs.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and menu-item hover ground. A hover state only, never a resting ground.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Ground for a selected row, a checked multi-select item, the active sidebar link. Pair with brand for its label.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted ground: tooltips, the command palette, the dark stat strip. Carries on-inverse text only.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse. 19:1 in light, 16:1 in dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative separation only: card edges, table row rules, section dividers. It does not meet 3:1, so never use it as the only thing marking an interactive control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Heavier decorative rule: table header underline, sidebar edge, the divider between a modal body and its footer.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The boundary of any control a person can act on: input, select, checkbox, switch track, secondary button. 3.7:1 on surface and 3.2:1 on surface-sunken in light, 3.8:1 in dark: it clears the 3:1 WCAG floor on every ground a control sits on.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings, table cell values, lead names, form labels. On surface, surface-raised, surface-page and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: column headers, helper copy, timestamps, the second line of a lead row. 7.5:1 on surface in light, 8.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and resting icons: placeholder text, eyebrow labels, chart axis labels. 5.5:1 on surface in light and 6.0:1 in dark, and it still clears 4.5:1 on surface-sunken, so it is body-legible everywhere it is used.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text and icons. Below 4.5:1 on purpose: WCAG exempts disabled controls, and a disabled field must read as unavailable. Never use it for live copy.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and on any solid status fill in the same theme.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive state: replied, verified, payment received, healthy metric. Deliberately cyan rather than green so it never has to be told apart from danger by hue alone. 5.4:1 on surface in light, 10.3:1 in dark.

tokens.name: success-surface
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and banners. Carries success as its text.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Decorative edge of a success badge or banner. The badge label carries the meaning, so this is not held to 3:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention state: follow-up overdue, stage stalled, email bounced once. 5.2:1 on surface in light, 9.7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and banners. Carries warning as its text.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Decorative edge of a warning badge or banner. The badge label carries the meaning, so this is not held to 3:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Negative state: lead lost, delivery failed, destructive action label. 5.9:1 on surface in light, 7.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Ground for danger badges and banners. Carries danger as its text.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Decorative edge of a danger badge or banner. An input in error takes the full-strength danger token as its border, because that edge does carry meaning.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Fill for a destructive confirm button. Pairs with on-danger, not with on-brand.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-solid: white in light (5.9:1), near-black in dark (5.0:1), because the dark fill is lightened to stay visible on a dark ground.

tokens.name: neutral-surface
tokens.usage: Ground for a neutral badge: an unstarted stage, an archived lead, a draft template. Carries ink-muted.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series, always the primary measure (leads created, revenue). The FFN blue leads every chart.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series. Cyan, separated from chart-1 by lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series. Amber.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series. Violet.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series, and the colour of any comparison or previous-period line.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Sixth chart series, and the only colour for a lost or failed measure.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the baseline rule. Decorative, never a data mark.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis labels and tick text in charts.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing and login screens only. Never inside the application shell.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Grow your startup without the noise.
styles.usage: Hero line on a full-page state: onboarding, the empty pipeline, an error page.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: The single biggest number on a dashboard stat card.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title in the app shell. One per screen.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title within a page, and the modal title.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Sub-block title, lead name in a row, list-group header.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Everything you see is filtered to your stage.
styles.usage: Long-form copy: email template bodies, onboarding paragraphs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sujatha moved this lead to SQL after the discovery call.
styles.usage: The application default. Table cells, form values, descriptions.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: An emphasised body run: the primary value in a table row, a name inside a sentence.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Last touched 3 days ago by Aashritha
styles.usage: Helper text, secondary row lines, timeline entries.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, footnotes, chart tick labels. Never for anything a person must act on.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field labels, button text at size md, tab labels.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Button text at size sm, badge text, table column headers.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section kicker above a heading, and the group label in a sidebar. Always set in ink-subtle.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Anything a person compares character by character: lead IDs, amounts, percentages, phone numbers, template keys.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: The same, inside dense table cells and badges.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: A metric value on a stat card when it sits beside its delta.

spacing.note: A strict 4px grid. Every gap, padding and inset in the product is one of these steps.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets only: the gap between a badge dot and its label.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a tight cluster: icon to label in a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in a button, gap between adjacent buttons, vertical gap inside a field group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a sm control, table cell vertical padding, gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of an md control, table cell horizontal padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on dense panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default card and modal padding, and the gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter inside the content column, gap between major dashboard blocks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space above a page title, padding of an empty state.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Separation between unrelated page regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of a full-page state such as login or a zero-data screen.

radius.note: The FFN mark is cut from hard diagonals and square terminals, so the system stays tight. Nothing in the product is rounder than radius-xl except an avatar or a dot.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, badge dot container, tag.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Badges, small tiles, the filled segment of a pipeline track.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table containers, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, the dashboard hero block.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status dots, the switch track and thumb. Nothing else.

shadow.note: Elevation is scarce. A card is defined by its border, not its shadow; shadows belong to things that genuinely float.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Resting buttons and inputs. The only shadow allowed on a control.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: A card lifted off surface-page on a dashboard.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers, the row action menu.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers, over a scrim.

layout.note: Fixed sizes the product repeats. Control heights are what keep a filter bar aligned across modules.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of a sm button, input, select or filter chip.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of the default button, input and select.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of a primary form or login control.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Width of the module sidebar in the app shell.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Width of the sidebar when collapsed to icons.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the app top bar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a content column. Tables and the pipeline board are allowed to run full bleed.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for email template bodies and any long-form copy.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Default data table row height. Dense mode uses 44px.
